clause: Non-destructive effect model core: StudioEffectStack + StudioLiveFilter entry structure [STU-FX-001,STU-FX-002,STU-FX-003,STU-FX-005,STU-FX-006,STU-FX-006b]

scope.summary: Implement the single non-destructive effect model on the canonical primitives StudioEffectStack (hsk.studio.effect_stack@1) + StudioLiveFilter: ordered re-editable/reorderable/enable-disable entries each carrying filter_kind (catalog key), typed parameter payload, StudioBlendMode+opacity, enabled flag, render_scope (layer|below|group), valid layer targets (R/V/T/G). Source raster tiles / vector network / text story preserved unchanged; result composed at render time by RenderEngine. No per-suite variant; no per-kind instance cap. Deduplicates smart-filter stack + live-filter layer + appearance stack + layer-effect panel into one model. Never fork the primitives (fields canonical in 14.23).
acceptance_criteria: StudioEffectStack+StudioLiveFilter compile on canonical primitives; non-destructive re-editable reorderable entries; render_scope + R/V/T/G targets; no fork
expected_tests: test: entry reorder re-composes deterministically; delete restores exact prior result (no quality loss)
test: source data unchanged after apply (non-destructive); render_scope layer|below|group honored
test: no per-kind instance cap; layer-target R/V/T/G enforced

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No non-destructive stack; every 14.9 family MT blocked or forks its own model.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
